text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on the property is confirmed. About 4.5 hectares of planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda) were lost, representing 0.12% of the 3,643.5-hectare asset. The loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by later observations (up to 2025) and the JRC 2020 reference data, which agreed on the entire event area. However, the evidence does not specify the cause (e.g., harvest, fire) or whether the change was legal.
